summary: FD_ED_TC_06_Authentication | OTP Service Down | System Unavailable | No Case Created
title: Authentication | OTP Service Down | System Unavailable | No Case Created
description:
OTP service is completely unavailable (system outage). Per call transcript, if major services like OTP are down, the chat will be disabled and users receive a "system unavailable" message. No shell case created.

Prerequisites:
OTP service: OFFLINE/DOWN (system outage); All other services operational; Customer attempts to file FD claim
